issues.display_title: Issue #283: fix(ui): Vertically and Horizontally Center Upload Login Modal
issues.main_description_html:
Background & Problem

When opening the upload modal for GoThru, Panorra, or Street View in an unauthenticated state (displaying the login form or SSO button), the dialog was positioned near the top of the viewport instead of the center.

This was caused by the default scrollBehavior="outside" styling in HeroUI overriding standard placement rules, resulting in an uncentered and visually unbalanced layout across varying screen resolutions.

Implemented Solution

  1. True Horizontal & Vertical Centering:

    • Switched modal scroll behavior to scrollBehavior="inside" when in login mode.
    • Applied explicit centering overrides (placement="center", flex !items-center !justify-center, and !my-auto) to ensure the dialog is centered both horizontally and vertically.

  2. Cross-Provider Consistency:

    • Applied uniform centering across all upload providers (GoThru, Panorra, and Street View).
    • Adjusted padding and layout spacing so dialogs render consistently regardless of viewport size.

Acceptance Criteria

  • The GoThru upload login modal is centered both horizontally and vertically.
  • The Panorra upload login modal is centered both horizontally and vertically.
  • The Street View upload login modal is centered both horizontally and vertically.
  • Dialog positioning remains stable and centered when resizing the application window.

issues.display_title: Issue #282: fix(upload): Prevent Account Loading Crash on Expired Local Tokens
issues.main_description_html:
Background & Problem

The application persists previously authenticated accounts in the local database to support multi-account switching. When opening the upload modal, it validates each stored account against the server.

The issue:

  • If a stored account has an expired session token on the server, the validation endpoint returns HTTP 401 (Unauthorized).
  • Account validation was executed via an all-or-nothing Promise.all. A single expired account caused the entire batch to reject, triggering an Uncaught (in promise) undefined error in the console.
  • Consequently, all other accounts—even valid and active ones—failed to load in the provider account selector.

Implemented Solution

  1. Resilient Account Verification:

    • Migrated account validation from Promise.all to Promise.allSettled.
    • Expired or rejected accounts are safely ignored without disrupting the validation of other accounts.
    • Active, valid accounts continue to be loaded and displayed in the dropdown selector.

  2. Eliminated Unhandled Rejections:

    • Prevented console crashes when verifying accounts whose credentials have lapsed on the server.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Active accounts continue to load and display in the upload modal even if expired tokens exist in local storage.
  • No Uncaught (in promise) undefined errors appear in the browser console during account loading.
  • Users can switch between valid accounts smoothly without UI blocking.

issues.display_title: Issue #281: fix(upload): Sync App Login Token to Upload and Resolve 401 on Tours List
issues.main_description_html:
Background & Problem

When a user signs in to the main application, that account should automatically become the active default account for the GoThru Upload module. Previously, the authentication token from the main app login was not synchronized to the upload state.

As a result:

  • When opening the GoThru upload modal, the application attempted to fetch the tours list (tours/list) before authentication tokens were available or with an empty token.
  • This produced HTTP 401 (Unauthorized) errors in the console and prevented tours from loading.
  • API endpoints also contained malformed duplicate slashes (//users/detail).

Implemented Solution

  1. Default Account Synchronization:

    • Automatically synchronizes the main app login token to the GoThru upload default token (gothruToken) and marks the account as default in the local database.
    • Added an automatic fallback: if gothruToken is not yet set, request helpers immediately fall back to the main app session token.

  2. Tour List Request Guard:

    • Added an authentication token check prior to loading tours list. Network requests are deferred until a valid token is present.

  3. URL Sanitization:

    • Added a URL builder helper to trim duplicate leading and trailing slashes across API requests.

Acceptance Criteria

  • The main app login account is immediately recognized as the default account in GoThru Upload without requiring a redundant sign-in.
  • The tours list (tours/list) loads successfully without triggering HTTP 401 Unauthorized errors.
  • API request URLs are properly sanitized without duplicate slashes.

issues.display_title: Issue #280: feat(upload): Support Isolated In-App SSO Login for GoThru Provider
issues.main_description_html:
Background & Objective

Previously, the GoThru account login flow in the Upload modal did not support Keycloak SSO (Single Sign-On). If SSO login were opened directly in the user's default OS browser (Chrome/Edge/Brave), the authentication session could collide with the user's personal browser accounts.

The objective of this task is to provide an isolated in-app browser window for GoThru Upload SSO so that the user's primary system browser session remains completely undisturbed.

Implemented Solution

  1. Isolated In-App Browser Window:

    • Implemented a dedicated in-app window with private/incognito mode enabled.
    • Cache, cookies, and session credentials are kept isolated within the ephemeral window without affecting the default OS browser.
    • Redirect callbacks are intercepted directly by the desktop application (on_navigation), and the login window automatically closes once authentication succeeds.

  2. Feature Flag Parity:

    • Aligned the Upload login experience with the core app login flow.
    • Checks the backend v1/feature-flags endpoint: when Keycloak SSO is enabled (keycloak_auth: true), displays the branded "Login with GoThru" SSO button; otherwise, falls back to the manual login form.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Users can sign in to GoThru Upload accounts using Keycloak SSO.
  • SSO authentication opens in an isolated in-app webview without polluting default system browser sessions.
  • The login window automatically closes upon successful authentication and the account is registered immediately.
  • The Upload login UI dynamically adapts based on the server's feature flag state.

issues.display_title: Issue #275: Add loading and status when generating on Object Remover - Edit
issues.main_description_html:
DEMO FROM DEVELOPER

Description

Currently, when generating / removing objects in Object Remover, there is no clear loading indicator or active status shown in the preview area while waiting for the process to complete. This leaves users waiting without clear feedback on whether the process is actually running or frozen.

Expected Behavior

  • Add a proper loading indicator and clear status feedback while the Object Remover is generating.
  • The loading state should automatically dismiss once the process finishes (either success or failed).

Acceptance Criteria

  • Visual loading indicator is displayed while generating.
  • Clear status feedback is shown during the generation process.
  • Loading state disappears and UI updates properly when the process is completed.

issues.display_title: Issue #292: Open app in fullscreen by default
issues.main_description_html:
DEMO FROM DEVELOPER

Description

The main window currently opens at a fixed size of 1700x920. The app should open in fullscreen by default.

Expected Behavior

  • The main window opens in fullscreen on launch.
  • The user can still leave fullscreen with the existing app:fullscreen menu toggle.

Implementation

Add "fullscreen": true to the main window in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json.

Note: on macOS, native fullscreen moves the app to its own Space. If a maximized window is preferred instead (title bar and dock stay visible), use "maximized": true.

Acceptance Criteria

  • App opens in fullscreen on Windows.
  • App opens in fullscreen on macOS.
  • Fullscreen toggle from the menu still works.
